title: At the hotel
goal: Explain a hotel problem and ask for help
freeConversationInstruction: What do you need in your hotel room? Compare what matters to you when you travel

pages.title: Review the last lesson
pages.instruction: Imagine you’re at the airport. Choose a hotel and a number of days

items.hint: I’m staying at the Park Hotel

items.hint: Sorry, can you say that again?

pages.title: Practise the conversation
pages.instruction: You are Ana and Teacher is Kim. Practise together, swap roles, then answer the questions

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Good evening. How can I help?
lines.audioText: Good evening. How can I help?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I’m in room 204. The shower doesn’t work
lines.audioText: I’m in room 204. The shower doesn’t work.
lines.translation: Estou no quarto 204. O chuveiro não funciona

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I’m sorry. Do you need a towel?
lines.audioText: I’m sorry. Do you need a towel?
lines.translation: Sinto muito. Você precisa de uma toalha?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes, please. Can I have two towels?
lines.audioText: Yes, please. Can I have two towels?
lines.translation: Sim, por favor. Posso pedir duas toalhas?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Of course. Someone can come at six. Is that OK?
lines.audioText: Of course. Someone can come at six. Is that OK?
lines.translation: Claro. Alguém pode ir às seis. Tudo bem?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes, thank you. I’ll be here
lines.audioText: Yes, thank you. I’ll be here.

questions.answer: The shower in Ana’s room doesn’t work

pages.title: Explain the room problem
pages.instruction: You’re a hotel guest. Imagine the light or the shower doesn’t work. I’m at reception

items.prompt: What’s the problem with your room?

items.hint: I’m in room two oh four

items.prompt: When can I send someone to help?
items.cue: Choose a time and check it with me
items.hint: At six, please. Is that OK?

pages.title: Make requests with can
pages.instruction: Use can to ask for something or ask someone to help

rows.subject: Ask for an item
rows.example: Can I have a towel, please?

rows.subject: Ask for an action
rows.example: Can you check the shower, please?

rows.subject: Say something is not possible
rows.example: I can’t open the window. She can’t turn on the light

pages.note: Can stays the same with every subject. The next verb is the base form: can open, can check. Do not add to or an -s ending.

pages.title: Role-play the situation
pages.instruction: Can you help me? Choose a room problem, tell reception your room number and ask for help

pages.title: Listen and answer
pages.instruction: Reception has an update. Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hello, Ana. This is reception. Someone can come to your room at seven this evening, not six. We have two towels for you here. You can collect them now, or we can bring them at seven. Please tell us what you need. Thank you!
pages.audioText: Hello, Ana. This is reception. Someone can come to your room at seven this evening, not six. We have two towels for you here. You can collect them now, or we can bring them at seven. Please tell us what you need. Thank you!
pages.greeting: Reception has a new time for you

items.prompt: When can someone come to Ana’s room?
items.answer: Someone can come at seven this evening

items.prompt: How many towels does reception have for her?
items.answer: Reception has two towels for Ana

items.prompt: How can Ana get the towels?
items.answer: Ana can collect them now or have them delivered at seven

pages.title: Respond to the message
pages.instruction: Confirm the new time. Use the message to update your response and agree on the next step

pages.title: Watch and answer
pages.instruction: Watch the guest ask for help, then explain a simple hotel problem

items.prompt: Is the room too hot or too cold?

items.hint: Listen for the item used to open the door

items.prompt: What does the receptionist offer to make?
items.answer: The receptionist offers to make a new key

items.prompt: Your room is too cold. What can you say?
items.hint: Say the problem and ask for help
items.answer: Example: My room is too cold. Can you help me, please?
